preconditions.description: The input string S must have a length between 2 and 10^5 (inclusive).

preconditions.expression: all(c.islower() and c.isalpha() for c in S)
preconditions.description: All characters in S must be lowercase English alphabet letters.

postconditions.expression: return_value == sum(1 for i in range(len(S)) for j in range(i+1, len(S)) if S[i] != S[j])
postconditions.description: The function returns the count of distinct strings obtainable by performing exactly one swap of two distinct characters at indices i and j (1 ≤ i < j ≤ |S|).
